title: The Ordinary day at the mill
subtitle: 社区社会 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）
meta: 主题语境：社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）　|　核心词汇：ordinary　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 ordinary 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1950 the director wrote of ① an ordinary day at the mill in the poster, and everybody in the theatre said at once that it was ② more ordinary than the one named there the year before. Three nights on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the director, who never explained anything, had done it in the rain and gone home; it was the ordinary ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most ordinary day at the mill anybody in the theatre had ever seen, or so the poster for August 1944 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too ordinary to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the actor who had come to help; the ordinary ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the script at the far stage, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an ordinary man in the street, and said that no actor in his right mind would call it ⑥ as ordinary as the man in the street they had once had in the old theatre. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was ordinary or not, and he said so.

By 1957 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the poster. What the line asked for was ⑦ something ordinary, and nothing besides. The actor from the next theatre called the whole plan ⑧ quite ordinary; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the poster kept the names of the ordinary ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1960, without complaint, she wrote of another ordinary day at the mill in the same poster, and the work, which took two nights, seemed ⑨ more ordinary than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most ordinary man in the street in the whole theatre, she said in 1962, was the one she could never quite name; the ordinary ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 普通（前置定语 an ordinary day at the mill：1950 年导演在戏报里记下的那件普通的一天）
B. adj. 普通／平常（比较级 more ordinary than：文中两处，一处比磨坊里平常的一天，一处比预想）
C. adj. 普通／平常（最高级 the most ordinary：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 普通（表语 too ordinary to do：母亲觉得它太普通，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 平常（前置定语 an ordinary man in the street：叔叔把整件事称作一桩平常的普通人）
F. adj. 平常（同级比较 as ordinary as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩街上的普通人相比）
G. adj. 平常（后置定语 something ordinary：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 平常（受程度副词修饰 quite ordinary：那位演员的评价）

items.q: an ordinary day at the mill
the most ordinary day at the mill anybody
an ordinary man in the street
The most ordinary man in the street in

answers.why: ordinary 意为“普通”，1950 年导演在戏报里记下的是“一件普通的一天”，此处作前置定语 an ordinary day at the mill。
ordinary 意为“普通”，此处用比较级 more ordinary than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
ordinary 意为“普通”，戏报上 八月 那行字说它是戏院里最普通的一件，故用最高级 the most ordinary day at the mill。
ordinary 意为“普通”，母亲认为这件东西“太普通了，谁也用不上”，too ordinary to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
ordinary 意为“平常”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩平常的普通人”，此处作前置定语 an ordinary man in the street。
ordinary 意为“平常”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩街上的普通人一样平常”，同级比较用 as ordinary as。
ordinary 意为“平常”，戏报上那半行字要的是“平常的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something ordinary。
ordinary 意为“平常”，邻戏院来的那位演员认为这套计划“相当平常”，quite 修饰原级 ordinary。
ordinary 意为“平常”，1960 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要平常”，故用比较级 more ordinary than。
ordinary 意为“平常”，母亲 1962 年说的是“整个戏院里最平常的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most ordinary man in the street。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1950 年，导演在戏报里记下了一件普通的一天。（an ordinary day at the mill）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更普通。（more ordinary than …）
母亲觉得它太普通，谁也用不上。（too ordinary to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩平常的普通人。（an ordinary man in the street）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩街上的普通人一样平常。（as ordinary as …）
到了 1957 年，戏报上只剩半行字：要的是一件平常的东西。（something ordinary）
answers: In 1950 the director wrote of an ordinary day at the mill in the poster.
Everybody said it was more ordinary than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too ordinary to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an ordinary man in the street.
He said nobody would call it as ordinary as the man in the street they had once had.
By 1957 the poster asked for nothing but something ordinary.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 ordinary 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1950 the director wrote of an ordinary day at the mill in the poster, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most ordinary day at the mill in the theatre, or so the poster says.
My mother thought it too ordinary to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an ordinary man in the street, and nobody argued with him.
The actor from the next theatre called the plan quite ordinary, and everybody laughed.
The ordinary ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
